tagline.en: An open vision-language-action policy for robot control, tracked as its own model entry.
tagline.zh: 一个用于机器人控制的开放视觉-语言-动作策略，作为独立模型条目收录。

en: OpenPIE 0.6 is a vision-language-action (VLA) policy for robot control, distributed openly on Hugging Face by the exla-ai project. It maps visual observations and a language instruction to robot actions, so a robot can follow natural-language commands to carry out manipulation tasks.

It is tracked in WorldFoundry as its own model entry, separate from the OpenPI pi0 / pi0.5 family, and is served through the in-tree policy runtime. Given observations, it produces an action trace you can roll out.
The policy checkpoint is obtained separately before you run it.
zh: OpenPIE 0.6 是一个用于机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，由 exla-ai 项目在 Hugging Face 上开放发布。它把视觉观测和一条语言指令映射为机器人动作，使机器人能按自然语言指令完成操作任务。
在 WorldFoundry 中，它作为独立的模型条目收录，与 OpenPI 的 pi0 / pi0.5 家族分开，并通过内置的策略运行时提供服务。给定观测，它会产出一段可推演的动作轨迹。
策略 checkpoint 需在运行前单独获取。

whenToUse.en: Use OpenPIE 0.6 when you want an openly available vision-language-action policy to drive a robot from visual input and language instructions.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一个公开可得的视觉-语言-动作策略，从视觉输入和语言指令来驱动机器人时，可以使用 OpenPIE 0.6。

notFor.en: A robot control policy, not a video or perception model — it expects observations and outputs actions. The checkpoint is supplied separately.
notFor.zh: 它是机器人控制策略，而非视频或感知模型——需要观测输入、输出动作。checkpoint 需单独提供。
